turns.content: For methyl 2-propyl-1,2,4a,5,6,7,8,8a-octahydronaphthalene-1-carboxylate, infer the diene, dienophile, tether, substituent mapping, and residual alkene required of an intramolecular Diels-Alder precursor.
State a retrosynthetic procedure that checks reactive-unit connectivity, tether length, substituent mapping, and residual unsaturation.
Construct a linear triene containing an alpha,beta-unsaturated ester dienophile and a remote conjugated diene positioned for intramolecular closure, including the required alkene geometries.
Can those reactive units and the tether close to the target fused bicyclic framework?
Map the ester-bearing and terminal alkyl portions of the triene onto the target substituents.
Why would a disconnected intermolecular diene/dienophile pair fail the tethered fused-ring and residual-unsaturation requirements?
Identify the precursor by its full stereochemical name.
Verify it by tracing both new sigma bonds, the surviving alkene, the ester-bearing carbon, and the propyl-bearing carbon.
Report the precursor and the concise intramolecular cycloaddition map.
